motionDescription.sourceText: Flat dominant hand touching chin/lips, moving downward and forward toward addressee

phonologicalParameters.handshape: Flat open hand (B-hand, fingers together, thumb alongside)
phonologicalParameters.location: Starts at chin / lower lip, finishes in neutral signing space in front of torso
phonologicalParameters.orientation: Palm facing inward toward chin at start; tilting slightly upward/forward at terminus
phonologicalParameters.movement: Smooth downward and forward trajectory toward addressee; slight accompanying head nod
phonologicalParameters.nonManualMarkers: Warm facial expression, slight respectful head nod, eye contact with recipient

motionDescription.regionalVariations: In some Indian Deaf communities, two-handed slight bow with Namaste gesture is used in formal situations to express deep gratitude, while the chin-forward gesture serves as standard conversational ISL 'Thank you'.

blockingReasons: No official raw ISLRTC video or landmark dataset for 'Thank You' is stored or licensed locally in the workspace.
No verified 3D motion-capture or keyframe animation asset exists.
Generating guessed or synthetic keyframes violates PRD non-hallucination principles.
